posts.title: Raúl Sánchez Architects transforms laundry into light-filled Barcelona home
posts.description: Spanish studio Raúl Sánchez Architects turned a former washhouse into Casa de las Lavanderas, with a lightwell that is a "modern translation of the old wells" used by local laundry workers.
